messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences that say this is NOT the case, naming both entities: Mado Systems produces Sepa Z82

response: Mado Systems does not produce Sepa Z82, and its catalogue contains no product by that name. Sepa Z82 comes from a different manufacturer, and Mado Systems has never been involved in building it.
